svg.title: Figure 09 · A shifted proposal for a rare exercise event
svg.desc: K = 180; other inputs use the one-year benchmark. Seed 1004. The proposal mean is the exercise threshold in normal coordinates. Every payoff is multiplied by the exact density ratio; changing the sampling law without weights would change the price.
